facts: As children Neela and Ammu saw Vellan's bear-shape standing over them in the Resin House yard (Ammu knows his shape only as a bear in the yard).
Neela already knows that girls are sent to the kennels as punishment, though not that 'released' members end there.
Ammu has stayed at a coast inn as the trader's girl Valli for about three weeks.
Chinna's gate gossip says the bride was seen at the window at dawn in her sleeping cloth; Ammu uses it to press Neela.
Neela's nails itch at the quick at sixteen nights, a warning that the ache is coming.
Chathu's message to Ammu, read from a twist of paper, repeats that every day counts double.
